metadata.title: Bangladesh District Tourist Spots and Popular Foods
metadata.scope: Curated planning starter dataset covering all 64 districts. Spots and foods are representative rather than exhaustive.
metadata.importantDisclaimer: Transport schedules, fares, hotel listings, ticket prices, opening hours, permissions and local access conditions change frequently. Null values are intentional: verify live details before booking or publishing.

verificationNotes.transport: Schedules, fares and availability are live data and are intentionally not invented.
verificationNotes.hotels: Named hotels and prices must be checked live before publication or booking.
verificationNotes.universities: Representative universities only. Verify current official names and UGC status before publication.
verificationNotes.historicalPlaces: Extracted from the curated district spot list and should be reviewed before commercial publication.

hotelDataSummary.policy: Only sourced named accommodations are embedded. Prices, contact details and availability remain nullable because they require live verification.

transportCostSummary.busBaseline: Approximate one-way road distance from Dhaka district town × BDT 2.23 per km regulated inter-district bus baseline.
transportCostSummary.busBaselineEffectiveReference: BRTA fare lists updated 2026-04-23; reported revised inter-district rate BDT 2.23/km.
transportCostSummary.trainCostMethod: Broad planning range only. Exact station-, train- and class-based fare must be checked through the official Bangladesh Railway e-ticket service.
transportCostSummary.launchCostMethod: Broad planning range only. Exact vessel-, cabin-, route- and season-based fare must be checked with the operator.
transportCostSummary.distanceDisclaimer: Road-distance values are approximate planning inputs and are not turn-by-turn navigation distances.
transportCostSummary.pricingDisclaimer: All costs are estimates. Verify live transport prices before publishing or booking.
